sources.title: How Will Rajasthan Use AI for Agriculture Services? | AIM
sources.snippet: As part of the collaboration, several AI-powered tools will be introduced to improve farmer outreach and agricultural decision-making. One of the platforms, Agrivani, is a multilingual AI chatbot that will allow farmers to interact through voice or text in local languages and receive agriculture-related guidance and advisory support.
